verdict.rationale: This story asks whether the product can act as an MCP client, connecting to external MCP servers and using their tools. Appwrite is a backend-as-a-service platform, not an agent or AI assistant that consumes tools, so the client axis is a category mismatch. The evidence only shows Appwrite publishing its own MCP server for agents like Claude Code and Cursor to connect to, which is the opposite (server) role and earns no credit here.
